payload.claim: Criterion 1's witness-construction notes give two contradictory definitions of TE-1's packaged head P: 'Its packaged head P is one commit on A, with line 8 rewritten again' (built from A, so p.py line 5 keeps A's original value) versus the later 'P's tree is T1 with line 8 rewritten' (built from T1, so p.py line 5 keeps T1's rewritten value). These differ because T1 rewrites both lines 5 and 8 from A. Verified with git that only the 'P built from T1' reading reproduces the outcome criterion 1 claims for the unstacked layer (line 8 unverified, line 2 stays qualified); building P literally 'on A' merges the line-5 and line-8 edits into one diff hunk under DIFF_FLAGS's --unified=3, spanning lines 2-11, which would wrongly mark the line-2 concern unverified too.
